title: Static Arcade
generation_prompt: Original 128-second stereo synthwave instrumental at fixed 116 BPM in 4/4. Start at full dance-chorus energy on the first beat with electronic kick on every beat, snare on two and four, eighth-note hats, pulsing octave bass, warm analog chords and a distinct short synth lead attack on each quarter beat. Signature melody: four descending clipped notes answered by two higher bell tones, with changing chord colors after 64 seconds. Keep the complete arrangement and similar loudness in every 8-second interval including the last; vary melody and bass rather than repeating an identical half. Bright retro-electronic timbres for an all-ages rhythm game. No intro, fade, breakdown, quiet bridge, tempo drift, vocals, speech, samples, known melodies or copying. Treat the very first second as the middle of an already-playing chorus at complete volume: drums, bass, chords and hook must all be present immediately; no filter sweep, slow opening, pad intro or build.
cover_prompt: Three offset glitch slits form an angular frequency portal, warm ivory with cyan and coral static marks; no arcade cabinet, cassette, vehicle, text or character.
og_prompt: Purpose-composed dark horizontal title card, static frequency slits on right, duohertz and Static Arcade on left.
